method: On public practice training pages only, collect certain word cards and line lengths separately for each IVTFF unit kind. For each manuscript line in its public page order, draw a length from the corresponding unit drawer and then that many word cards independently with replacement from the same drawer; no special line-initial or glyph rule is used. Seed 272026. Reject any card completing a manuscript four-word run. This samples different whole-word vocabularies by visual line kind, allowing label/paragraph differences without language; it uses the public layout but no evaluation words for fitting.
